You can use be supposed to when talking about actions or events that you or someone expect to happen
Big companies or business are supposed to need special designed tools so they can operate and handle enormous amounts of information
Use be supposed to in the present tense to talk about actions that are expected or that always happen in the same way.
Structure</br>Subject + am/is/are + supposed to + verb + complement</br>

Example:
Students are supposed to come to class until November 17th
Employees are not supposed to be late to any meeting
Use be supposed to talk about actions that people expected in a certain condition in the past but are not longer true
Structure</br> Subject + was/were + supposed to + verb + complement

Examples
I was supposed to send the email before Friday, but I couldn't.
Animals were supposed to be a good therapy for my son, but he is allergic to their fur.
Be supposed to in present in future tense
Use it to talk about actions people will expect from you when certain conditions are met.
Structure</br> Subject + will be + supposed to + verb + complement

Examples
As soon as you arrive to USA, you will be supposed to go directly to the office, we need you to sign some papers urgently.

images.text: Big companies and business are supposed to use specially designed tools to operate and handle enormous amounts of information. For that reason, Oracle Database has developed different features and tools that help companies with such big tasks. One of these tools is Data Warehousing: it is not meant to be used for transactions but it focuses on query and analysis, instead. Data warehousing stores historical data that has been retrieved from the transaction data. It helps consolidate data from different sources. This process receives the name of ETL; it extracts the information and then processes such data in order to load a result. Sometimes, the indexes are larger than the table data. For this reason, data warehousing can also use bitmap indexes, which are only a fraction of the original ones and help locate information easily.

Data warehousing was not supposed to be the only tool for business intelligence features. There are other features:
Materialized View: It improves query performance by allowing the access to table data; then it stores the results in a separate schema object that can be viewed and stored in any database,
Table Compression: Huge amounts of data won't be supposed to occupy all the disk space of a system. That's why Oracle has permitted data compression to ALL DATA, including backups and network traffics; this reduces the storage consumption.

Parallel Execution: One simple process is not supposed to handle all the work necessary for the system to run; multiple processes work simultaneously dividing this work and making it faster. It comes handy when working with large databases.
Very Large Databases: Big companies handle information that surpasses standards. In these cases, partitioning is pivotal. It generates partitions in the data, no modifications, just how it is organized permitting a consistent performance.

Describing data management tools

• Write a 150-170 word formal text in which you describe the features of any company warehouse or software manager tool, you like.

• Include an opening and a closing line.

• Be very descriptive and use the present perfect to characterize the tool.

• Express clearly what this tool is supposed to do.

It's time to review your text.

When you are writing your text, remember to include:

• A title
• Different characteristics of the software.
• Your own observations using figurative language.
• A closing line.

Proofread your text for any spelling, grammar or punctuation errors.
